description: Claims that must never appear in generated content, configuration, or documentation for this accelerator. Enforced by scripts/validate-docs.mjs, which skips this file because it necessarily contains the phrases it forbids. Entries are matched case-insensitively as substrings of Markdown prose.
notes: Only unambiguous claim phrases belong here. Phrases that a safety statement would legitimately negate are deliberately excluded, because a substring scan cannot read negation.
Identifier and credential leakage is covered separately by scripts/scan-secrets.mjs.
